text: Only if it is your family's custom.
Kumari puja is the Navaratri tradition of honouring young girls as forms of the Devi.
Invite the girl to the puja with her parents' consent, and only if she would like to come too.
Explain the puja to her in a way she can easily understand.
See the girl as a form of the Devi and bow to her.
Following your family's custom, and only if she is happy with it, apply gandham and a kumkuma bottu and offer her flowers.
Do pada puja too only if she is comfortable with it.
Offer her prasadam, fruit or a meal.
Honour her with a small gift she will like.
Note: If the girl feels uncomfortable at any point, do not continue the puja.
Respecting her wishes is the very spirit of this puja.
Families who do not perform it can simply continue their usual puja to the Devi.
